description: This file defines the interface for the DbusMgr class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The class provides methods to obtain GDBusProxy and GDBusConnection objects for interacting with NetworkManager over D-Bus, used in network management operations.

classes.name: DbusMgr
classes.description: A manager class providing access to various NetworkManager D-Bus proxies and connection

methods.name: getNetworkManagerProxy
methods.description: Returns a GDBusProxy for the main NetworkManager object

methods.name: getNetworkManagerSettingsProxy
methods.description: Returns a GDBusProxy for NetworkManager settings

methods.name: getNetworkManagerSettingsConnectionProxy
methods.description: Returns a GDBusProxy for a specific connection settings object identified by connPath

methods.name: getNetworkManagerDeviceProxy
methods.description: Returns a GDBusProxy for a device identified by devicePath

methods.name: getNetworkManagerWirelessProxy
methods.description: Returns a GDBusProxy for wireless device

methods.name: getNetworkManagerIpv4Proxy
methods.description: Returns a GDBusProxy for IPv4 configuration

methods.name: getNetworkManagerIpv6Proxy
methods.description: Returns a GDBusProxy for IPv6 configuration

methods.name: getNetworkManagerActiveConnProxy
methods.description: Returns a GDBusProxy for active connection

methods.name: getNetworkManagerAccessPointProxy
methods.description: Returns a GDBusProxy for access point

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns a GDBusConnection for D-Bus communication

methods.name: getNetworkManagerPropertyProxy
methods.description: Returns a GDBusProxy for device properties

methods.name: getNetworkManagerDhcpv4Proxy
methods.description: Returns a GDBusProxy for DHCPv4 configuration

methods.name: getNetworkManagerDhcpv6Proxy
methods.description: Returns a GDBusProxy for DHCPv6 configuration
